title: [v0.92][runtime] Operationalize distributed Runtime and polis Observatory across Wuji and AWS
body:
## Goal

Operationalize the merged distributed Runtime as a real three-voter polis through production Guardian and kernel entrypoints and expose exactly one quorum-leased polis Observatory. Run two live demonstrations strictly serially: first three voters on Wuji, then one Wuji voter plus two independently stateful AWS voters in distinct Availability Zones.

## Configuration and shepherd

The canonical Runtime init configuration must include an explicit `shepherd_agent_ref` and governed per-node provider/model profiles. The shepherd launches with the polis, has a distinct non-exportable governed identity, is never a consensus voter, and cannot mint membership, lease, snapshot, fence, activation, mutation, or Observatory authority. Premature AWS shepherd activation and Observatory binding must fail closed.

Wuji may use three smaller local models so all voters fit concurrently. Model capability must never alter authority semantics. Every Wuji and AWS voter uses a pinned, bounded, private self-hosted model through the supported `ollama_http` contract or a separately reviewed compatible local provider. AWS must prove private endpoints, exact artifact identity, restart, bounded cold start, inference under load, hard CPU/memory isolation from consensus, no hosted-model fallback, and complete model-cache teardown.

## Phase A: Wuji only

- Launch exactly three real authenticated Guardian/kernel voters on Wuji.
- Launch the configured non-voting shepherd with the polis.
- Show exactly one live coherent redacted polis Observatory containing all three voters.
- Prove authenticated traffic, a governed mutation, one-voter loss with retained quorum, recovery or truthful fail-closed behavior, and bounded shutdown.
- Produce a complete cleanup receipt for every process, Observatory, port, lock, lease, credential, model, and test root.

Phase B must not start until Phase A cleanup is proven. The two phases must never overlap.

## Phase B: Wuji and AWS continuity

- Verify `agent-logic-admin` resolves to the approved Agent Logic business account.
- Launch one Wuji voter and two AWS voters in distinct Availability Zones with independent state, volumes, interfaces, roles, and private local-model services.
- Govern-admit the distinct AWS shepherd identity while all three voters are healthy.
- Have Wuji propose a snapshot boundary that quorum commits; require both AWS committed indices to match and all healthy voters to independently materialize the same canonical snapshot digest through the native snapshot/catalog path. Manual copying and uncommitted local history are non-proving.
- Serially compact and restart each AWS voter from its snapshot while the other two preserve quorum.
- Saturate bounded local inference while proving consensus timing and starvation safety.
- Keep Wuji alive but asymmetrically partition it without any harness bridge. Require both AWS votes to elect a newer AWS leader before the safety window, Wuji fence, owner activation, and continued governed mutation.
- Wait for the old quorum-enforced Wuji Observatory lease TTL to expire, then activate the AWS shepherd and acquire exactly one replacement Observatory lease. Show the single running Observatory on AWS.
- Heal the partition without restarting Wuji; prove stale Wuji cannot mutate, renew, own the Observatory, or serve stale reads, then demotes and synchronizes only through governed rejoin/recovery.
- Re-partition Wuji and stop the opposite-AZ AWS voter; the remaining one-of-three AWS voter must halt mutation while the colocated shepherd remains alive and reports loss of quorum.
- Tear down every ephemeral compute, volume, network attachment, SSM session, credential, process, model cache, Observatory, port, lock, and test root.

## Production integration remediation

This issue restores the original live #5878 contract that PR #140 narrowed. Completion requires real production Guardian/kernel launch, authenticated API and WSS continuity, live partition, quorum fencing, migration, recovery, continued mutation, Observatory movement, and bounded shutdown. Library registration or in-process module tests alone do not satisfy the issue.

The retained proof contract must also validate truthfully after squash merge onto `main` and reject any protected production, test, config, runner, API, or proof-contract change after the proving revision unless a new exact receipt and review are produced.

## Review and merge

The implementation receives a fresh independent exact-head review. The PR remains unmerged until both serial live demonstrations have been shown to the operator and every required check is green. Lifecycle closeout reconciliation is asynchronous and intentionally outside this implementation issue.

Plan review: Gemini `gemini-3.1-pro-preview`, final verdict APPROVE, review id `2RN6atenNYbgz7IPmomJ4As`.
